title: Inspiring Artwork by Students
theme: Student art gallery — ocean, climate, and coral themes

items.alt: Painting of a heating Earth under rising temperatures, with melting ice, storms, wildfire, and heat affecting living creatures.
items.description: Undoubtedly, our planet's temperature keeps rising; icebergs melting, massive storms occurring more often, the number of wildfires is increasing, and the heat waves are becoming a part of our weather. These environmental changes affect negatively to all living creatures on Earth, including humans. If we don't significantly reduce the heat, our plant will have a massive collapse.

items.title: GLOBAL WARMING
items.alt: Dynamic-angle painting of a melting umbrella as Earth flooding a landscape of fossils, including human remains.
items.description: As a result of this fact, I have expressed my anxiety about the future environment aggressively through painting; using dynamic angles. In which I caused a flood from a melting umbrella, that figuratively showed our planet, earth, and fossils, including human fossils, that floated around the flooded area.

items.title: Ocean, sea, beach…
items.alt: Artwork of coral bleaching: a person with burn-like injuries beside a head covered in corals shifting from living color to white.
items.description:
Sea creatures have been one of my inspirations. I am still amazed by their colors, shapes, and how they interact with each other. Unfortunately, I may not be able to see them anymore in 5 years time because coral bleaching is a serious risk. Corals are also animals, which means they can feel pain like we do.

To express this message, I have depicted a coral bleaching event showing a person suffering with burns, and created a head with corals that show the bleaching process.

items.title: Salish Sea Rose
items.alt: Painting of a rose-like form in blues and greens suggesting the Salish Sea.
items.description: Student artwork linking the Salish Sea to a rose form in cool ocean colors.
